recorded_baseline.basis: recorded exposed v3 replay; not rerun by this task

G2.title: Convention-qualified lexical usage and source-bound interpretation

reuse.limits: Enumeration is complete relative to the installed ledger; establishment and actual-use judgments require evidence.

reuse.purpose: Qualified positive/negative obligations and conflicts, without a new inference calculus.
Retain bounded lexical candidates/selection and sourceful acquisition as distinct receipts. Existing finite phrase families remain regression cases.
Installed source/ledger replay and native checking; no implicit default convention may resolve an unknown context.

usage_schema_proposal.name: source_binding
usage_schema_proposal.meaning: Exact source/revision/raw bytes and lexical/cue spans

usage_schema_proposal.name: community_id
usage_schema_proposal.meaning: Usage community to which the convention applies
usage_schema_proposal.reuse: Existing convention string is a key, not a structured community proof

usage_schema_proposal.name: domain_id
usage_schema_proposal.reuse: No typed domain guard in the existing Designation

usage_schema_proposal.name: convention_id_and_version
usage_schema_proposal.meaning: Stable versioned link to convention evidence

usage_schema_proposal.name: designation_valid_time
usage_schema_proposal.meaning: Period attested for a designation; unknown stays unknown
usage_schema_proposal.reuse: Existing citation identity retained; temporal applicability requires a new contract

usage_schema_proposal.name: utterance_context_and_time
usage_schema_proposal.meaning: Actual occurrence context, distinct from dictionary dating
usage_schema_proposal.reuse: Frame.occurrence.context; extension for explicitly checked time/community

usage_schema_proposal.name: designation_evidence_refs
usage_schema_proposal.meaning: Evidence that the expression is established for the sense

usage_schema_proposal.name: usage_evidence_refs
usage_schema_proposal.meaning: Exact cue source/spans and interpretation rule for this occurrence

usage_schema_proposal.name: candidate_scope
usage_schema_proposal.meaning: Candidate-set identity, completeness scope and open obligations

usage_schema_proposal.name: reference_binding
usage_schema_proposal.meaning: Grounded referent if evidenced, otherwise explicit unresolved status
usage_schema_proposal.reuse: Existing outputs declare reference unresolved; external binding is not supplied by morphology

new_sources_needed: Attested designation for each new sense
Evidence locating each special convention by community/domain/time when claimed
Exact contextual source and interpreted cue for each selected-use expectation
Independent source review for any reference or intention claim
freeze_preconditions: Choose scope and sources before authoring semantic expectations
Review authored interpretation separately from source byte integrity
Freeze source/protocol then an independently authored matrix before changing production interpretation
Record exposed legacy v3 cases separately from genuinely held-out material
Keep candidate recall, unique selection, sourceful chain and external truth as separate outcomes
prohibitions: Do not set used-sense evidence merely because the candidate was selected
Do not infer world truth or actual author intention from bounded phrase matching
Do not treat unresolved acquisition as successful end-to-end interpretation
Do not erase unresolved alternative senses to obtain a singleton
G2.dependency_note: Semantic ledger/source review can proceed in parallel; final joined-chain acceptance requires source/acquisition/reading dependencies appropriate to each case.

G4.title: Qualified observation, source lineage, conflict and withdrawal

reuse.limits: Properties of the declared active-source/support model, not source authenticity.
Independence excludes the query origin in the declared ancestry graph. It does not prove statistical or pairwise source independence, sensor fidelity, or authenticity.

reuse.purpose: Existing input validation, bounded inference and native replay for the qualified ledger.
Replay of source-relative inquiry and explicit world-bridge limits; cannot be promoted from source entailment to outside truth.

event_schema_proposal.name: event_id_and_entity_id
event_schema_proposal.meaning: Bind linguistic reference to a specified occurrence/entity
event_schema_proposal.reuse: Key.entity and context; richer event binding is not automatically acquired

event_schema_proposal.name: predicate_value_unit_place_context
event_schema_proposal.meaning: Qualified content of the claim and observation

event_schema_proposal.name: valid_time
event_schema_proposal.meaning: Time/interval to which the observation applies
event_schema_proposal.reuse: Current Key.time is Int; interval semantics need an explicit bridge

event_schema_proposal.name: observed_at
event_schema_proposal.meaning: Collection/recording time, separate from event validity time
event_schema_proposal.reuse: No automatic distinction in current Key.time

event_schema_proposal.name: source_revision_origin_parents
event_schema_proposal.meaning: Retained source identity and derivation graph

event_schema_proposal.name: collector_and_method
event_schema_proposal.meaning: Who collected what, using which tool and trust contract
event_schema_proposal.reuse: Declared source adapter; no outside authentication theorem

event_schema_proposal.name: active_and_revocation
event_schema_proposal.meaning: Active-source selection and retained withdrawal history

event_schema_proposal.name: predicate_conflict_contract
event_schema_proposal.meaning: Whether two qualified values contradict under the same circumstance
event_schema_proposal.reuse: Different values are not automatically opposite polarity

query_origin_plan: Give the query and each evidence record a retained origin ID
Retain copy/quote/derivation parent edges rather than creating independence by renaming
Validate origin references and closed ancestry before selection; missing provenance blocks an independence claim
Use the existing transitive-query-origin exclusion check on the complete declared lineage
If a policy requires multiple independent sources, add a separate evidence-backed pairwise dependence contract; distinct names are insufficient
Do not use a world witness derived from the query itself to establish that query
withdrawal_plan: Preserve the old source/receipt and withdrawal reason
Remove the withdrawn source from active support and identify dependent certificates
Recompute current support/conflict from active admissible evidence
Retain an independently supported result where applicable; otherwise suspend it
Never turn withdrawn positive evidence into new negative evidence
new_sources_or_contracts_needed: Collector/source authenticity profile when an outside-truth claim is intended
Predicate-specific conflict and unit conversion rules
Evidence-backed lineage and any claimed pairwise independence
G4.evaluation_boundary: Start with explicitly synthetic ledger scenarios for contract testing. Synthetic success is not an external measurement or proof of actual-world truth.
G4.dependency_note: The structured-observation contract can be developed in parallel with G2. A language-to-world chain needs separately verified lexical/reading/reference and evidence bridges.

shared_limits: No 120-case or 40-case matrix was created by this protocol task
No semantic expected answer is prefilled without a selected source and independent review
No frozen productive_clause_v1 source or gold file is changed
Language-internal usage cues may originate in the analyzed text; this never makes the text independent evidence of its asserted event
Existing declared-graph guarantees are not promoted to source authenticity or universal source independence
Any semantic extension needs a versioned contract, source scope, counterexamples and current native/formal integration checks
review_and_freeze_sequence: exposed repairs and original results retained
